Server API

group FIRMWARE_DISTRIBUTION_SERVER_API

Server-side functions for firmware distribution.

Functions

bool fw_dist_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Firmware distribution server register.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index where server is registered.

  • model_data_cb -- [in] Callback function for model data processing.

Return values:

  • true -- if registration successful.

  • false -- if registration fails due to invalid element.

Returns:

Registration status.

void fw_dist_server_caps_set(fw_dist_caps_t *pcaps)

Set firmware distribution server capabilities.

Parameters:

pcaps -- [in] Pointer to the server capabilities structure.

fw_dist_caps_t fw_dist_server_caps_get(void)

Get firmware distribution server capabilities.

Return values:

fw_dist_caps_t -- The capabilities structure of the server.

Returns:

Firmware distribution capabilities structure.

fw_image_e_t *fw_dist_server_get_image_by_index(uint16_t index)

Get image information.

Parameters:

index -- [in] Index of the image to retrieve information.

Return values:

fw_image_e_t -- *A pointer to the image entity structure.

Returns:

Pointer to firmware image structure.

bool fw_dist_server_is_receiver_empty(void)

Check if receiver list is empty in firmware distribution server.

Return values:

  • true -- if receivers list is empty.

  • false -- if receivers list contains entries.

Returns:

Receiver list empty status.

void fw_dist_server_delete_all_receiver(void)

Delete all receivers from firmware distribution server.

bool fw_dist_server_add_image(fw_image_t *pimage)

Add distribution image to firmware distribution server.

Parameters:

pimage -- [in] Pointer to the firmware image structure.

Return values:

  • true -- if successfully added.

  • false -- if add operation fails.

Returns:

Add image status.

void fw_dist_server_delete_all_image(void)

Delete all images from firmware distribution server.

bool fw_dist_server_delete_image(uint8_t *pfw_id, uint8_t fw_id_len)

Delete a specific distribution image from the server.

Parameters:

  • pfw_id -- [in] Pointer to the firmware ID buffer.

  • fw_id_len -- [in] Length of the firmware ID.

Return values:

  • true -- if successfully deleted.

  • false -- if deletion fails.

Returns:

Delete image status.

int32_t fw_dist_handle_blob_server_data(const mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, uint32_t type, void *pargs)

Handle blob transfer server data callback.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to blob transfer server model information.

  • type -- [in] Data callback message type.

  • pargs -- [in] Pointer to data callback arguments.

Return values:

Returns -- the status or result of handling blob server data.

Returns:

Result of callback processing.

void fw_dist_server_start(uint16_t app_key_index, uint8_t update_ttl, uint16_t update_timeout_base, uint8_t blob_id[8], uint8_t *pfw_metadata, uint8_t metadata_len)

Start firmware distribution process on server.

Parameters:

  • app_key_index -- [in] Application key index used in the process.

  • update_ttl -- [in] Update TTL value for transmission.

  • update_timeout_base -- [in] Base timeout value converted from seconds.

  • blob_id -- [in] Blob identifier for the distribution process.

  • pfw_metadata -- [in] Pointer to firmware metadata buffer.

  • metadata_len -- [in] Length of the metadata.

void fw_dist_server_dist_failed(void)

Notify failure of firmware distribution process.

void fw_dist_server_set_upload_recvd_size(uint32_t upload_recvd_size)

Set upload received firmware size on server.

Parameters:

upload_recvd_size -- [in] Size of uploaded firmware received in bytes.

void fw_dist_server_upload_oob_done(bool success)

Notify completion status of OOB firmware upload.

Parameters:

success -- [in] true for upload success; false for upload failure.
